changeSet.sql: create table data.users( id serial4 NOT NULL, user_id int8 NOT NULL, is_bot boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, first_name varchar(256) NOT NULL, last_name varchar(256), username varchar(256), language_code varchar(16), is_premium boolean, added_to_attachment_menu boolean, can_join_groups boolean, can_read_all_group_messages boolean, supports_inline_queries boolean, is_admin boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ts_db_begin timestamp DEFAULT LOCALTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, ts_db_end timestamp, constraint users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), constraint uk_users_user_id UNIQUE (user_id) );
